parameters.content:
## 08-19-02 automate reference check outreach and tracking with AI

### How it works

When a candidate is hired, the recruiting team logs the new hire and their referees on a webhook. An AI agent drafts a personalized reference request email for each referee. Each request is logged to an Airtable table with a status and the email is sent to the referee. When a referee submits a reference (rating, recommendation and feedback) on the response webhook, the record is updated to received. Once every referee for a candidate has responded, the workflow gathers all feedback and an AI agent writes a balanced reference summary that is emailed to the hiring manager and posted on Discord. Every day a sweep finds requests that have been waiting longer than 2 days and reminds the recruiting team on Discord plus email.

### Setup steps

- Create an Airtable base with a ReferenceCheck table using the exact field names from the workflow nodes (request_id, candidate_name, candidate_email, job_title, manager_email, referee_name, referee_email, relationship, status, requested_at, received_at, reminded, rating, recommend, feedback).
- Connect Airtable, Gmail, OpenAI and Discord credentials on the matching nodes.
- Point your ATS or intake form at the refcheck/intake webhook; point your reference form at the refcheck/respond webhook.
- Set the hiring manager and recruiter email addresses used by the nodes.
- Set the daily sweep schedule.

### Customization

Change the AI prompts, add a hosted form for referees, or swap Discord for Slack or Telegram.

## Intake and validation

A new hire needs a candidate name and email. Missing fields are rejected and alerted on Discord plus email.

## Draft, log and send

Each referee gets a personalized AI drafted request email, logged to Airtable as requested, then emailed.

## Daily stale sweep

Every day, requests waiting longer than 2 days are listed for the recruiting team on Discord and by email.
